start: A member with 4 months of logged workouts, on the free part of MettleUp Plus, on the Progress tab

user_sees: Page 'Charts': 'Last 7 days' with '<n> workouts' and a body map; 'Sets per muscle group' on '3 months'; 'Muscle distribution'; 'Main exercises'; 'Records'; Strength score; 'Reports'
must_not: A '1 workouts' word; a workout from 8 days ago in Last 7 days

steps.action: Under Sets per muscle group, tap 'Month', untick a muscle group
user_sees: Bars by month for the ticked groups; the headline counts each set once
must_not: The last muscle group unticked (at least one stays)

user_sees: Sets this period against the one before; tiles 'Workouts', 'Time', the lifted figure and 'Sets' with change lines
must_not: Change arrows against a period the log only partly covers

start: A member on the free part of MettleUp Plus, on Charts

steps.action: Tap '12 months' or 'All time' under Sets per muscle group
user_sees: A note that older charts are part of MettleUp Plus, with a way to the Plus page; the range stays on 3 months
must_not: Charts older than 3 months shown for free; the 30-day and 3-month ranges asking for Plus

steps.action: A gym member whose gym gives Plus taps '12 months'
must_not: A Plus question to a member who has Plus through the gym

start: A new member with no finished workout

user_sees: 'No workouts yet' with 'Your charts show here once you finish a workout.'
must_not: Empty charts with zeros; NaN in a tile

steps.action: The phone's workout store fails to read
user_sees: A load error for 'your charts' with a way to try again

start: A member with workouts but none for the picked muscles in the range

steps.action: Tick only one group with no sets in the range
user_sees: 'No sets for these muscles in this range.'
must_not: An empty chart with no words

user_sees: 'Beat a previous best and it shows here.'

start: A member on Charts who finishes or deletes a workout

steps.action: Finish a workout, come back to Charts
user_sees: Last 7 days and the totals include it (read again on each visit)
must_not: The old numbers until the app restarts

steps.action: Delete that workout from history, come back
user_sees: It is gone from every section and from Records
must_not: A record kept from the deleted workout

steps.action: Plus through the gym ends while '12 months' is picked, come back
user_sees: The range asks for Plus again on the next pick
must_not: Old charts still free for good
